reviews.title: Works great, quiet  as a mouse.
reviews.comment:
I was hesitant to buy this as the reviews for Apevia products were not the best.  But I needed it quickly and the price was right.  Worked perfectly, no noise, no issues.  Lots of cables and connectors.  Some could have been a bit longer, but I also could have found a way to reroute them or added an extender.
No regrets.
reviews.author: David

reviews.title: Worked perfect. Arrived EARLY.
reviews.comment: Installed it into the PC I just bought, plugged everything in and it works perfectly. ALSO while it said out of stock it ended up arriving nearly a week earlier than the date it said it would, which was a pleasant surprise.
reviews.author: Devon M

reviews.title: Item and Customer support is terrible
reviews.comment: Bought as a replacement, after 1 week of use the the fan started growling very loud. Customer support would send a return label and wanted me to send unit back before receiving replacement, so the computer would be unusable for 2 to 3 weeks. Unacceptable, computer is need for daily use. Will not buy this product again.
reviews.author: B
